tasks.spec:
You are a repo feature worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repository, detached at HEAD. Edit files here directly.

OWNERSHIP: you own exactly two paths, factory/outbox_push.py (existing) and tests/test_outbox_push_buzz.py (new). Do NOT modify, create, delete, or reformat anything else under factory/, tests/, kernel/, runbooks/, departments/, or loopfactory.py. Do NOT git commit, do NOT git push, do NOT run git add -A. Leave your changes uncommitted; the check exports them.

CONTEXT AND THE GAP YOU ARE CLOSING. factory/outbox_push.py turns a department's escalation into two things: a phone notification and a Linear card. The owner answers from his phone using Telegram inline buttons, and those buttons carry the Linear card identifier inside their callback data, because tapping one posts a comment onto that specific card. Today the ping sender runs BEFORE the card is created, so it cannot possibly carry the identifier. The result is that the owner gets a plain text nudge with no buttons, and has to open Linear to answer. Everything on the far side of this, the buttons and the comment grammar, is already built and deployed. This one wiring step is what is missing.

READ FIRST, READ-ONLY, for conventions: factory/outbox_push.py in full, especially load_config, tick, _render, _send, _send_captured, _last_json_object and _append_ledger; and tests/test_outbox_push.py for the subprocess test style.

BUILD a THIRD, OPTIONAL sender called buzz, alongside the existing ping and card.
1. load_config accepts senders.buzz as an argv template list. It is OPTIONAL: a config without it must keep working exactly as it does now. When present it must be validated the same way ping and card are, a non-empty list of non-empty strings.
2. In tick, AFTER the card sender has succeeded AND a card identifier was actually parsed from its output, render and run the buzz template. Placeholders: {card} for the identifier, plus the existing {department}, {kind} and {text}.
3. The buzz must NOT run when card creation failed, or when no identifier could be parsed, or when card_enabled is false. Buttons pointing at a card that does not exist would let the owner approve something with no durable record behind it.
4. A buzz that FAILS must NOT fail the tick and must NOT stop the run. The card already exists and is the durable record; losing the phone nudge must never lose the alert. Log the failure at warning level and make sure the word buzz appears in that message so an operator can grep for it.
5. Do not change the existing ping behaviour, the exit 3 total-ping-failure path, the exit 4 stall path, the cursor and row-hash dedup, or the ledger append.

NOTE on identifier parsing: the card identifier is already extracted from the card sender's stdout inside the ledger path via _last_json_object. The buzz needs that same identifier. Make the parsing happen once and be used by both, rather than parsing twice or making the buzz depend on whether a ledger is configured. A buzz must work even when no ledger_file is set.

WRITE tests/test_outbox_push_buzz.py covering the five behaviours above, following the subprocess style in tests/test_outbox_push.py. Your tests are not the acceptance gate; an independent oracle drives the CLI through fixtures you have not seen.

VERIFY before you finish, from the worktree root:
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
The whole suite must stay green.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: leave the two owned files edited and uncommitted, and write ./notes.md at the ROOT of your worktree (the check copies it out before the worktree is deleted) recording what you read, what you changed, the exact verification command and its result, and any assumption.

HARD RULES: never add an allow-on-failure path to anything that already fails closed. No new dependencies. No network. Do not load skills or call MCP/Apps. Do not capture anything to any memory or brain service.
tasks.verified: an independent oracle confirmed the buzz sender fires exactly once after a successful card creation and is rendered with the real card identifier, does not fire when card creation fails, does not fail the tick when the buzz itself fails while still naming buzz in the log, and stays optional so existing configs keep working; and the full repo suite still passes.
